title: A CRM duplicate review: how the pilot works
description:
What you send and what you get back: the CRM cleanup review sheet pilot for small sales teams.

CRM Duplicate and Data-Quality Check: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#crm #dataquality

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/crm-cleanup?src=youtube&utm_campaign=crm-cleanup-how-it-works
narration: How the CRM cleanup pilot works.
You send a contacts export. Before you do, we agree in writing how the data is handled and when it's deleted.
You get duplicate groups with a suggested record to keep, data-quality issues, and a proposed-changes sheet.
No CRM login, no emailing your contacts, and no list buying.
One export of up to 5,000 records, one report. The price and terms are on the page.
